# `foxglove sessions get`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](sessions.md)

```text
Get a session by ID or key

Usage: foxglove sessions get [OPTIONS] <SESSION_ID_OR_KEY>

Arguments:
  <SESSION_ID_OR_KEY>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --project-id <PROJECT_ID>
          Project ID (defaults to FOXGLOVE_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID, then saved default_project_id; --project-id= bypasses defaults)

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
